   184	/-! ## Inhabitation at exponent `0`, for EVERY widened cover
   185	
   186	At `a = 0` the theta cocycle is trivial (`relThetaCocycle_zero`), so a global theta section is
   187	a pair of sections of the STRUCTURE sheaf on `V₀`, `V₁` agreeing on the overlap — and the two
   188	pinned charts cover the curve.  One gluing therefore produces a genuine global section, and the
   189	reading on a piece is that section restricted.  Note where the covering is used: `V₀ ⊔ V₁ = ⊤`
   190	is a statement about the CURVE, applied before any piece is mentioned.  No piece is required to
   191	sit inside a chart, which is exactly the difference from `ChartTyping`. -/
   192	
   193	section ZeroExponent
   194	
   195	variable (C R π)
   196	
   197	/-- **The two pinned charts cover the curve**, in the `⊤ ⊓ ·` spelling the theta components
   198	live over. -/
   199	lemma le_iSup_top_inf_relPinnedChart :
   200	    (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ ⨆ b : Bool, (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π b :=
   201	  fun z _ => by
   202	    have hz : z ∈ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊔ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := by
   203	      rw [relCover_sup]; trivial
   204	    rcases Opens.mem_sup.mp hz with h | h
   205	    · exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨false, ⟨trivial, h⟩⟩
   206	    · exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨true, ⟨trivial, h⟩⟩
   207	
   208	/-- **A global theta section at exponent `0` glues to a global section of `𝒪`.**  Its two
   209	components agree on the chart overlap because the cocycle is `1` there, and the charts cover. -/
   210	lemma existsUnique_glueThetaZero (x : relThetaSections C R π 0) :
   211	    ∃! s : Γ(relCurve C R, ⊤), ∀ b : Bool,
   212	      (relCurve C R).resHom
   213	          (inf_le_left : (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π b ≤ ⊤) s
   214	        = relThetaResSide 0 b inf_le_right x := by
   215	  refine (relCurve C R).sheaf.existsUnique_gluing'
   216	    (fun b : Bool => (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π b) ⊤
   217	    (fun b => homOfLE inf_le_left) (le_iSup_top_inf_relPinnedChart C R π)
   218	    (fun b => relThetaResSide 0 b inf_le_right x) ?_
   219	  intro i j
   220	  -- the matching law at exponent `0`, where the side unit is `1`
   221	  have hle : ((⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π i)
   222	        ⊓ ((⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π j)
   223	      ≤ relPinnedChart C R π i ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π j :=
   224	    inf_le_inf inf_le_right inf_le_right
   225	  have hmatch := relThetaResSide_matching 0 i j hle x
   226	  rw [AffAdaptation.relThetaSideUnit_zero (C := C) (R := R) (π := π) i j hle, Units.val_one,
   227	    one_mul] at hmatch
   228	  rw [show relThetaResSide 0 i (hle.trans inf_le_left) x
   229	      = (relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_left :
   230	          ((⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π i)
   231	            ⊓ ((⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π j)
   232	          ≤ (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π i)
   233	        (relThetaResSide 0 i inf_le_right x) from
   234	    (resHom_relThetaResSide 0 i inf_le_right inf_le_left x).symm,
   235	    show relThetaResSide 0 j (hle.trans inf_le_right) x
   236	      = (relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_right :
   237	          ((⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π i)
   238	            ⊓ ((⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π j)
   239	          ≤ (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π j)
   240	        (relThetaResSide 0 j inf_le_right x) from
   241	    (resHom_relThetaResSide 0 j inf_le_right inf_le_right x).symm] at hmatch
   242	  exact hmatch
   243	
   244	/-- The glued global section of a theta section at exponent `0`. -/
   245	noncomputable def glueThetaZero (x : relThetaSections C R π 0) : Γ(relCurve C R, ⊤) :=
   246	  (existsUnique_glueThetaZero C R π x).choose
   247	
   248	lemma resHom_glueThetaZero (x : relThetaSections C R π 0) (b : Bool) :
   249	    (relCurve C R).resHom
   250	        (inf_le_left : (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π b ≤ ⊤)
   251	        (glueThetaZero C R π x)
   252	      = relThetaResSide 0 b inf_le_right x :=
   253	  (existsUnique_glueThetaZero C R π x).choose_spec.1 b
   254	
   255	/-- Uniqueness, in the form the linearity proofs consume. -/
   256	lemma glueThetaZero_eq_of_forall {x : relThetaSections C R π 0} {s : Γ(relCurve C R, ⊤)}
   257	    (h : ∀ b : Bool, (relCurve C R).resHom
   258	        (inf_le_left : (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π b ≤ ⊤) s
   259	      = relThetaResSide 0 b inf_le_right x) :
   260	    s = glueThetaZero C R π x :=
   261	  (existsUnique_glueThetaZero C R π x).unique h
   262	    ((existsUnique_glueThetaZero C R π x).choose_spec.1)
   263	
   264	/-- **The gluing is `R`-linear**, as a map out of the theta sections at exponent `0`. -/
   265	noncomputable def glueThetaZeroHom :
   266	    relThetaSections C R π 0 →ₗ[R] Γ(relCurve C R, ⊤) where
   267	  toFun := glueThetaZero C R π
   268	  map_add' x y := by
   269	    refine (glueThetaZero_eq_of_forall C R π (fun b => ?_)).symm
   270	    rw [map_add, resHom_glueThetaZero, resHom_glueThetaZero, map_add]
   271	  map_smul' r x := by
   272	    refine (glueThetaZero_eq_of_forall C R π (fun b => ?_)).symm
   273	    -- `resHom` commutes with the `overModule` scalar action; both spellings of that lemma in
   274	    -- the tree are `private` (`Cohomology/TwistedSheaf.lean:122`, `GluedSheaf.lean:108`), so
   275	    -- the two-line unfolding is inlined rather than re-exported (inbox `I-0712`).
   276	    have hsmul : (relCurve C R).resHom
   277	        (inf_le_left : (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π b ≤ ⊤)
   278	          (r • glueThetaZero C R π x)
   279	        = r • (relCurve C R).resHom

   284	      exact (relCurve C R).overAlgebraMap_apply_res R (homOfLE inf_le_left).op r

   289	/-- **THE PRODUCER: every widened cover carries a twisting datum at exponent `0`.**  No
   290	hypothesis on the pieces beyond `AffCoverData` itself — in particular a STRADDLING cover, on
   291	which `ChartTyping` is empty (`AffAdaptation.isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling`), carries one.
   292	
   293	The reading is the glued global section restricted to the piece; the comparison unit is `1`,
   294	because at exponent `0` there is nothing to compare — the two chart components are two views of
   295	one global section rather than two independent data.  The germ law holds with `u = 1` for the
   296	same reason.
   297	
   298	`0` is not a vacuous corner: it is the exponent `DivisorAdaptation.divisorDatum` runs at
   299	(`thetaIdealUnit_zero`, `Picard/DivisorDatumInverse.lean:207`), i.e. the twist in which the
   300	divisor's own class is read. -/
   301	noncomputable def AffCoverData.thetaTrivDataZero (D : AffCoverData C R) :
   302	    ThetaTrivData (π := π) D 0 where
   303	  read j := (relResAlgHom C R (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ ⊤)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ glueThetaZeroHom C R π
   304	  unit _ _ := 1
   305	  matching i j x := by
   306	    -- both sides restrict the SAME global section into the overlap
   307	    simp only [Units.val_one, one_mul, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
   308	      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, relResAlgHom_apply]
   309	    change (relCurve C R).resHom _ ((relCurve C R).resHom (le_top : D.pieces i ≤ ⊤) _)
   310	      = (relCurve C R).resHom _ ((relCurve C R).resHom (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ ⊤) _)
   311	    rw [Scheme.resHom_resHom, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   312	  germ_read j b z hzj hzb x := by
   313	    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
   314	    rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]
   315	    -- both germs are the germ of ONE global section: the glued one
   316	    have hleft : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) z hzj).hom
   317	        (relResAlgHom C R (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ ⊤) (glueThetaZero C R π x))
   318	        = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ ⊤ z trivial).hom (glueThetaZero C R π x) :=
   319	      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
   320	    have hright : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
   321	        ((⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π b) z ⟨trivial, hzb⟩).hom
   322	          (relThetaResSide 0 b inf_le_right x)
   323	        = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ ⊤ z trivial).hom (glueThetaZero C R π x) := by
   324	      rw [← resHom_glueThetaZero C R π x b]
   325	      exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
   326	    -- `glueThetaZeroHom … x` is `glueThetaZero … x` by `rfl`, but `rw` is reducible-only
   327	    -- against the folded bundled name, so the fold is discharged by `show` first.
   328	    change ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) z hzj).hom
   329	        (relResAlgHom C R (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ ⊤) (glueThetaZero C R π x))
   330	      = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
   331	          ((⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π b) z ⟨trivial, hzb⟩).hom
   332	        (relThetaResSide 0 b inf_le_right x)
   333	    exact hleft.trans hright.symm
   334	
   335	/-- **THE SEPARATION, which is the point of the file.**  On a cover with a straddling piece —
   336	one holding a point off `V₀` and a point off `V₁` — the new twisting index is INHABITED while
   337	`ChartTyping` is EMPTY.

   339	So `ThetaTrivData` is strictly wider than `ChartTyping` on exactly the covers protection
   340	`I-0492`'s widening exists for, and the widened Θ-layer's vacuity there
   341	(`AffAdaptation.isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling`, reviewer item `I-0779`) is a defect of the
   342	index rather than of the layer's mathematics. -/
   343	theorem nonempty_thetaTrivData_and_isEmpty_chartTyping (D : AffCoverData C R) (j : D.index)
   344	    {x y : relCurve C R} (hxj : x ∈ D.pieces j) (hyj : y ∈ D.pieces j)
   345	    (hx₀ : x ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ : Set (relCurve C R)))
   346	    (hy₁ : y ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ : Set (relCurve C R))) :
   347	    Nonempty (ThetaTrivData (π := π) D 0) ∧ IsEmpty (ChartTyping C R π D) :=
   348	  ⟨⟨D.thetaTrivDataZero⟩,
   349	    AffAdaptation.isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling (π := π) D j hxj hyj hx₀ hy₁⟩

    11	/-!
    12	# The global theta cokernel and the widened intrinsic range
    13	
    14	A widened certificate supplies fibrewise vanishing for `O(a Theta - d)`.  After choosing
    15	an auxiliary chart presentation of the same local equations, the existing rigid engine
    16	turns those witnesses into vanishing of the first cohomology of its theta-ideal sheaf.
    17	The canonical sheaf inclusion from `DivisorThetaSheafSequence` therefore has a surjective
    18	cokernel projection on global sections.
    19	
    20	The range of that inclusion on global sections is exactly the cover-independent vanishing
    21	submodule.  Hence the cokernel is canonically the same quotient already identified with
    22	the range of intrinsic widened theta evaluation.  No chart typing of the widened cover and
    23	no additional hypothesis occur.
    24	-/

    51	theorem thetaIdealInclApp_top_eq_gluedToVanishing (B : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
    52	    (a : ℕ) (s : B.ThetaIdealSections a ⊤) :
    53	    B.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) ⊤ s =
    54	      ((B.gluedToVanishingₗ a s :
    55	        d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
    56	          (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a)) :
    57	        relThetaSections C R π a) := by
    58	  rfl

    60	/-- The pointwise range of the theta-ideal sheaf inclusion on global sections is exactly
    61	the intrinsic, cover-independent divisor-family vanishing submodule. -/
    62	theorem range_thetaIdealInclApp_top (B : DivisorAdaptation C R π d) (a : ℕ) :
    63	    LinearMap.range (B.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) ⊤) =
    64	      d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
    65	        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) := by
    66	  ext x
    67	  constructor
    68	  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    69	    rw [thetaIdealInclApp_top_eq_gluedToVanishing C R π B a s]
    70	    exact (B.gluedToVanishingₗ a s).property
    71	  · intro hx
    72	    let y : ↥(d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
    73	        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a)) := ⟨x, hx⟩
    74	    refine ⟨(B.gluedEquivVanishing a).symm y, ?_⟩
    75	    rw [thetaIdealInclApp_top_eq_gluedToVanishing C R π B]
    76	    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((B.gluedEquivVanishing a).apply_symm_apply y)

    79

    81	the sheaf cokernel.  Keeping this at an arbitrary open is useful when the intrinsic

    85	theorem cokernelπ_app_eq_zero_of_germ_mem (B : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
    86	    {a : ℕ} {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    87	    (x : (relThetaTwistSheaf C R π a).obj.obj (op W))
    88	    (hx0 : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (hz : z ∈ W ⊓
    89	      (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀),
    90	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (W ⊓
    91	        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) z hz).hom x.val.1 ∈ d.stalkIdeal z)
    92	    (hx1 : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (hz : z ∈ W ⊓
    93	      (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁),
    94	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (W ⊓
    95	        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) z hz).hom x.val.2 ∈ d.stalkIdeal z) :
    96	    ((cokernel.π (B.thetaIdealIncl (a := a))).hom.app (op W)).hom x = 0 := by
    97	  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := B.exists_thetaIdealInclApp_of_germ_mem (a := a) x hx0 hx1

    99	  have hnat := congrArg
   100	    (fun f : (B.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf ⟶ cokernel (B.thetaIdealIncl (a := a)) =>
   101	      f.hom.app (op W)) (cokernel.condition (B.thetaIdealIncl (a := a)))
   102	  have hlin := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hnat
   103	  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hlin s

   302	    ((cokernel.π (B.thetaIdealIncl (a := a))).hom.app

    92	          A.thetaPieceVanishing (π := π) a j := by

   108	        (hpiece j) (Sum.inl PUnit.unit) z ⟨hj, by

   138	/-- The quotient by divisor-family vanishing is canonically the actual range of intrinsic
   139	theta evaluation.  Thus right exactness is precisely the assertion that this range is the
   140	whole intrinsic descent module. -/
   141	noncomputable def intrinsicThetaQuotEquivRange (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) :
   142	    (relThetaSections C R π a ⧸
   143	        d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
   144	          (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a)) ≃ₗ[R]
   145	      ↥(LinearMap.range (A.intrinsicThetaEvalRel (π := π) a)) :=
   146	  (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (A.ker_intrinsicThetaEvalRel (π := π) a).symm).trans
   147	    (A.intrinsicThetaEvalRel (π := π) a).quotKerEquivRange

    11	/-!
    12	# Fibrewise H1 witnesses on the widened divisor carrier
    13	
    14	The chart-typed fibre theorem in `DivisorThetaFibreData.lean` has two geometric inputs:
    15	
    16	* a certified adaptation stays certified after passing to a residue field, so its fibre
    17	  presentation divisor has the certificate degree;
    18	* subtracting that fibre divisor from a sufficiently positive theta window gives a divisor
    19	  with the required Picard class and vanishing `H1`.
    20	
    21	Neither input depends on a chart typing of the adaptation cover.  This file proves both for
    22	`AffAdaptation`, whose pieces are arbitrary affine opens.  The conclusion is deliberately the
    23	geometric witness itself, rather than a hypothesis about a not-yet-constructed widened Cech
    24	engine: it is directly reusable by any right-exactness or classifier construction on the
    25	widened carrier and introduces no new premise.

    27	## Main declarations
    28	
    29	* `AffAdaptation.IsCertified.deg_presentationDivisor_pulledEquations` -- the fibre divisor of
    30	  a widened certified adaptation has the certificate degree.
    31	* `AffAdaptation.IsCertified.fibrewise_thetaSub_h1_witness` -- at every residue field, the
    32	  explicit divisor `N(a) - d_p` has the transported theta-minus-family class and vanishing
    33	  `H1` once `a` is in the existing high window.
    34	* `AffAdaptation.IsCertified.exists_chartAdaptation_thetaGluedEval_surjective` -- an auxiliary
    35	  finite chart presentation of the same local equations has surjective high-window evaluation;
    36	  the chart presentation is extracted, not assumed or certified.

   604	    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}

   613	        secRes (cokernel (B.thetaIdealIncl (a := a)))

   616	            (op (D.pieces j))).hom

   635	piecewise exactness to compare the resulting global lift back to those representatives. -/

   637	    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
   638	    {A : AffAdaptation D d} (B : DivisorAdaptation C R π d) (a : ℕ)
   639	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective

   641	        (op (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens))).hom) :
   642	    Function.Surjective (A.intrinsicThetaEvalRel (π := π) a) := by
   643	  intro y
   644	  choose r hr using fun j : D.index =>
   645	    Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective (A.thetaPieceVanishing (π := π) a j) (y.val j)

   647	      A.thetaToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j (Submodule.Quotient.mk (r i)) =
   648	        A.thetaToOverlapRight (π := π) a i j (Submodule.Quotient.mk (r j)) := by
   649	    intro i j
   650	    have hy := (A.mem_intrinsicThetaGluedSubmodule_iff (π := π) a y.val).mp
   651	      y.property ⟨i, j⟩

   654	  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_thetaCokernel_global_of_compatible_representatives

   662	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j

   664	      (secRes (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf
   665	        (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens))
   666	        ((gluedTwistEquiv C R π a (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens)).symm x)) =
   667	      y.val j

   672	        (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens))
   673	        (((cokernel.π (B.thetaIdealIncl (a := a))).hom.app
   674	          (op (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens))).hom x) =
   675	      secRes (cokernel (B.thetaIdealIncl (a := a)))
   676	        (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens)) q := by
   677	          rw [hx]

   679	        (op (D.pieces j))).hom

    11	/-!
    12	# Intrinsic theta restrictions on widened divisor-family pieces
    13	
    14	The widened cover of `AffAdaptation` consists of arbitrary affine opens.  It therefore
    15	cannot use a pinned-chart trivialization of the theta cocycle.  Instead, on each piece
    16	`D.pieces j` we choose the affine sections model of the intrinsic cocycle-glued theta
    17	line bundle `(thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf`.  Its sections are an invertible module
    18	over the piece ring.
    19	
    20	Base change along the quotient
    21	`Gamma(D.pieces j) -> A.colength j = Gamma(D.pieces j) / (A.eqn j)` gives the intrinsic
    22	restriction of the theta line bundle to the piece of the finite divisor.  Invertibility
    23	is preserved by this base change.  A widened certificate then makes the colength algebra
    24	finite projective over `R`, so the existing invertible-module transfer gives finite and
    25	projective `R`-modules without any chart typing or additional hypothesis.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	set_option autoImplicit false
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace
    33	open scoped TensorProduct
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	
    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    40	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    41	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
    42	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    43	
    44	namespace AffAdaptation
    45	
    46	/-- The intrinsic theta sections on the widened affine piece `j`. -/
    47	noncomputable abbrev ThetaPieceSections (_A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    48	    (j : D.index) : Type u :=
    49	  (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf.obj.obj (op (D.pieces j))
    50	
    51	/-- A canonical choice of the finite projective invertible sections model of the
    52	intrinsic theta line bundle on the widened affine piece `j`.  The choice internally
    53	refines the arbitrary piece by basic opens subordinate to the theta cover; it does not
    54	type the piece itself into either pinned chart. -/
    55	noncomputable def thetaPieceSectionsModel (_A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    56	    (thetaChartDatum C R π a).AffineSectionsModel (D.pieces j) :=
    57	  Classical.choice ((thetaChartDatum C R π a).nonempty_affineSectionsModel
    58	    (D.pieces j) (D.isAffineOpen j))
    59	
    60	/-- The piece-ring action on intrinsic theta sections selected by
    61	`thetaPieceSectionsModel`. -/
    62	@[reducible]
    63	noncomputable def thetaPieceSectionsModule (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    64	    Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    65	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf (D.pieces j) :=
    66	    (A.thetaPieceSectionsModel (π := π) a j).qcoh
    67	  Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE (F := (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf)
    68	    (le_refl (D.pieces j))
    69	
    70	/-- The intrinsic restriction of `O(a Theta)` to the divisor inside the widened piece
    71	`j`: tensor theta sections with the equation quotient `A.colength j`. -/
    72	noncomputable abbrev ThetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    73	    (j : D.index) : Type u :=
    74	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    75	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
    76	  A.colength j ⊗[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)] A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j
    77	
    78	/-- The intrinsic theta restriction is invertible over the piece-local colength algebra.
    79	This is base-change stability of invertible modules. -/
    80	theorem invertible_thetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    81	    Module.Invertible (A.colength j) (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) := by
    82	  let M := A.thetaPieceSectionsModel (π := π) a j
    83	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf (D.pieces j) := M.qcoh
    84	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    85	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
    86	  haveI : Module.Invertible Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
    87	      (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) := M.invertible
    88	  change Module.Invertible (A.colength j)
    89	    (A.colength j ⊗[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)]
    90	      A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j)
    91	  infer_instance
    92	
    93	/-- Under the existing widened certificate, every intrinsic theta restriction is finite
    94	over the test ring. -/
    95	theorem IsCertified.finite_thetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) {n : ℕ}
    96	    (hc : A.IsCertified n) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    97	    Module.Finite R (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) := by
    98	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    99	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
   100	  haveI : Module.Invertible (A.colength j)
   101	      (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) :=
   102	    A.invertible_thetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j
   103	  haveI : Module.Finite R (A.colength j) := hc.finite_colength j
   104	  exact Module.Invertible.finite_trans (A := A.colength j)
   105	
   106	/-- Under the existing widened certificate, every intrinsic theta restriction is
   107	projective over the test ring. -/
   108	theorem IsCertified.projective_thetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) {n : ℕ}
   109	    (hc : A.IsCertified n) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
   110	    Module.Projective R (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) := by
   111	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
   112	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
   113	  haveI : Module.Invertible (A.colength j)
   114	      (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) :=
   115	    A.invertible_thetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j
   116	  haveI : Module.Projective R (A.colength j) := hc.projective_colength j
   117	  exact Module.Invertible.projective_trans (A := A.colength j)
   118	
   119	end AffAdaptation
   120	
   121	end AlgebraicGeometry

    11	/-!
    12	# Intrinsic theta restrictions on widened divisor-family pieces
    13	
    14	The widened cover of `AffAdaptation` consists of arbitrary affine opens.  It therefore
    15	cannot use a pinned-chart trivialization of the theta cocycle.  Instead, on each piece
    16	`D.pieces j` we choose the affine sections model of the intrinsic cocycle-glued theta
    17	line bundle `(thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf`.  Its sections are an invertible module
    18	over the piece ring.
    19	
    20	Base change along the quotient
    21	`Gamma(D.pieces j) -> A.colength j = Gamma(D.pieces j) / (A.eqn j)` gives the intrinsic
    22	restriction of the theta line bundle to the piece of the finite divisor.  Invertibility
    23	is preserved by this base change.  A widened certificate then makes the colength algebra
    24	finite projective over `R`, so the existing invertible-module transfer gives finite and
    25	projective `R`-modules without any chart typing or additional hypothesis.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	set_option autoImplicit false
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace
    33	open scoped TensorProduct
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	
    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    40	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    41	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
    42	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    43	
    44	namespace AffAdaptation
    45	
    46	/-- The intrinsic theta sections on the widened affine piece `j`. -/
    47	noncomputable abbrev ThetaPieceSections (_A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    48	    (j : D.index) : Type u :=
    49	  (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf.obj.obj (op (D.pieces j))
    50	
    51	/-- A canonical choice of the finite projective invertible sections model of the
    52	intrinsic theta line bundle on the widened affine piece `j`.  The choice internally
    53	refines the arbitrary piece by basic opens subordinate to the theta cover; it does not
    54	type the piece itself into either pinned chart. -/
    55	noncomputable def thetaPieceSectionsModel (_A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    56	    (thetaChartDatum C R π a).AffineSectionsModel (D.pieces j) :=
    57	  Classical.choice ((thetaChartDatum C R π a).nonempty_affineSectionsModel
    58	    (D.pieces j) (D.isAffineOpen j))
    59	
    60	/-- The piece-ring action on intrinsic theta sections selected by
    61	`thetaPieceSectionsModel`. -/
    62	@[reducible]
    63	noncomputable def thetaPieceSectionsModule (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    64	    Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    65	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf (D.pieces j) :=
    66	    (A.thetaPieceSectionsModel (π := π) a j).qcoh
    67	  Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE (F := (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf)
    68	    (le_refl (D.pieces j))
    69	
    70	/-- The intrinsic restriction of `O(a Theta)` to the divisor inside the widened piece
    71	`j`: tensor theta sections with the equation quotient `A.colength j`. -/
    72	noncomputable abbrev ThetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    73	    (j : D.index) : Type u :=
    74	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    75	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
    76	  A.colength j ⊗[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)] A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j
    77	
    78	/-- The intrinsic theta restriction is invertible over the piece-local colength algebra.
    79	This is base-change stability of invertible modules. -/
    80	theorem invertible_thetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    81	    Module.Invertible (A.colength j) (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) := by
    82	  let M := A.thetaPieceSectionsModel (π := π) a j
    83	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf (D.pieces j) := M.qcoh
    84	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    85	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
    86	  haveI : Module.Invertible Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
    87	      (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) := M.invertible
    88	  change Module.Invertible (A.colength j)
    89	    (A.colength j ⊗[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)]
    90	      A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j)
    91	  infer_instance
    92	
    93	/-- Under the existing widened certificate, every intrinsic theta restriction is finite
    94	over the test ring. -/
    95	theorem IsCertified.finite_thetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) {n : ℕ}
    96	    (hc : A.IsCertified n) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    97	    Module.Finite R (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) := by
    98	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    99	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
   100	  haveI : Module.Invertible (A.colength j)
   101	      (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) :=
   102	    A.invertible_thetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j
   103	  haveI : Module.Finite R (A.colength j) := hc.finite_colength j
   104	  exact Module.Invertible.finite_trans (A := A.colength j)
   105	
   106	/-- Under the existing widened certificate, every intrinsic theta restriction is
   107	projective over the test ring. -/
   108	theorem IsCertified.projective_thetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) {n : ℕ}
   109	    (hc : A.IsCertified n) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
   110	    Module.Projective R (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) := by
   111	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
   112	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
   113	  haveI : Module.Invertible (A.colength j)
   114	      (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) :=
   115	    A.invertible_thetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j
   116	  haveI : Module.Projective R (A.colength j) := hc.projective_colength j
   117	  exact Module.Invertible.projective_trans (A := A.colength j)
   118	
   119	end AffAdaptation

   121	end AlgebraicGeometry

   330	    Module.Finite R (A.ThetaGlued a) := by

   340	    (hproj : Module.Projective R A.Glued) :
   341	    Module.Projective R (A.ThetaGlued a) := by
   342	  haveI := hproj

   350	`n` as the untwisted one — the input `divisorWindowGr` consumes. -/

     9	/-!
    10	# The theta-ideal inclusion as a morphism of sheaves
    11	
    12	The chart presentation `thetaIdealDatum` is the line bundle `O(a Theta - d)`.  Its
    13	piecewise equations assemble on the two theta charts to a section of `O(a Theta)`.
    14	This file packages that assembly as the canonical monomorphism of sheaves
    15	
    16	`O(a Theta - d) -> O(a Theta)`.
    17	
    18	The construction uses the already established `gluedToIdeal₀/₁` assemblies.  Their
    19	restriction laws give naturality, their theta-overlap comparison gives the target
    20	twist relation, and regularity of the local equations gives monicity.  Consequently,
    21	vanishing of `H^1(O(a Theta - d))` makes the cokernel projection surjective on global
    22	sections by the general six-term cohomology slice.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    27	
    28	universe u
    29	
    30	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	
    36	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    37	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    38	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
    39	
    40	namespace DivisorAdaptation
    41	
    42	variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    43	
    44	/-! ## The sectionwise inclusion -/
    45	
    46	variable (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d) (a : ℕ)
    47	
    48	/-- The chart-zero component of the theta-ideal inclusion over an arbitrary open. -/
    49	noncomputable def thetaIdealInclFst (W : (relCurve C R).Opens)
    50	    (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) :
    51	    Γ(relCurve C R, W ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) :=
    52	  gluedToIdeal₀ A a inf_le_right
    53	    (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left s)
    54	
    55	/-- The chart-one component of the theta-ideal inclusion over an arbitrary open. -/
    56	noncomputable def thetaIdealInclSnd (W : (relCurve C R).Opens)
    57	    (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) :
    58	    Γ(relCurve C R, W ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) :=
    59	  gluedToIdeal₁ A a inf_le_right
    60	    (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left s)
    61	
    62	variable {A a}
    63	
    64	/-- The two assembled components satisfy the theta twist relation. -/
    65	theorem thetaIdealIncl_mem (W : (relCurve C R).Opens)
    66	    (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) :
    67	    (A.thetaIdealInclFst a W s, A.thetaIdealInclSnd a W s) ∈
    68	      twistSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
    69	        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) W := by
    70	  rw [mem_twistSubmodule_iff]
    71	  let V₀ := (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
    72	  let V₁ := (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁
    73	  have hOmega : W ⊓ V₀ ⊓ V₁ ≤ V₀ ⊓ V₁ :=
    74	    le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right
    75	  have h0 := gluedToIdeal₀_secRes (A := A) (a := a)
    76	    (inf_le_left : W ⊓ V₀ ⊓ V₁ ≤ W ⊓ V₀)
    77	    (inf_le_right : W ⊓ V₀ ≤ V₀)
    78	    (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left s)
    79	  have h1 := gluedToIdeal₁_secRes (A := A) (a := a)
    80	    (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right : W ⊓ V₀ ⊓ V₁ ≤ W ⊓ V₁)
    81	    (inf_le_right : W ⊓ V₁ ≤ V₁)
    82	    (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left s)
    83	  rw [secRes_secRes] at h0 h1
    84	  have hcmp := gluedToIdeal₀_eq_theta_mul_gluedToIdeal₁ (A := A) (a := a) hOmega
    85	    (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf)
    86	      (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left : W ⊓ V₀ ⊓ V₁ ≤ W) s)
    87	  exact h0.symm.trans (hcmp.trans (congrArg
    88	    (fun t => (relCurve C R).resHom hOmega
    89	      ((relThetaCocycle C R π a : Γ(relCurve C R, V₀ ⊓ V₁)ˣ) :
    90	        Γ(relCurve C R, V₀ ⊓ V₁)) * t) h1))

    92	private lemma thetaIdealInclFst_add (W : (relCurve C R).Opens)
    93	    (s t : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) :
    94	    A.thetaIdealInclFst a W (s + t) =
    95	      A.thetaIdealInclFst a W s + A.thetaIdealInclFst a W t := by
    96	  change gluedToIdeal₀ A a inf_le_right
    97	      (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left (s + t)) =
    98	    gluedToIdeal₀ A a inf_le_right
    99	        (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left s) +
   100	      gluedToIdeal₀ A a inf_le_right
   101	        (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left t)
   102	  rw [map_add, gluedToIdeal₀_add]
   103	
   104	private lemma thetaIdealInclSnd_add (W : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   105	    (s t : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) :
   106	    A.thetaIdealInclSnd a W (s + t) =
   107	      A.thetaIdealInclSnd a W s + A.thetaIdealInclSnd a W t := by
   108	  change gluedToIdeal₁ A a inf_le_right
   109	      (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left (s + t)) =
   110	    gluedToIdeal₁ A a inf_le_right
   111	        (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left s) +
   112	      gluedToIdeal₁ A a inf_le_right
   113	        (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left t)
   114	  rw [map_add, gluedToIdeal₁_add]
   115	
   116	private lemma thetaIdealInclFst_smul (W : (relCurve C R).Opens) (r : R)
   117	    (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) :
   118	    A.thetaIdealInclFst a W (r • s) = r • A.thetaIdealInclFst a W s := by
   119	  change gluedToIdeal₀ A a inf_le_right
   120	      (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left (r • s)) =
   121	    r • gluedToIdeal₀ A a inf_le_right
   122	      (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left s)
   123	  rw [map_smul, gluedToIdeal₀_smul]
   124	
   125	private lemma thetaIdealInclSnd_smul (W : (relCurve C R).Opens) (r : R)
   126	    (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) :
   127	    A.thetaIdealInclSnd a W (r • s) = r • A.thetaIdealInclSnd a W s := by
   128	  change gluedToIdeal₁ A a inf_le_right
   129	      (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left (r • s)) =
   130	    r • gluedToIdeal₁ A a inf_le_right
   131	      (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left s)
   132	  rw [map_smul, gluedToIdeal₁_smul]
   133	
   134	/-- The theta-ideal inclusion on sections over one open. -/
   135	noncomputable def thetaIdealInclApp (W : (relCurve C R).Opens) :
   136	    A.ThetaIdealSections a W →ₗ[R]
   137	      (relThetaTwistSheaf C R π a).obj.obj (op W) where
   138	  toFun s := ⟨(A.thetaIdealInclFst a W s, A.thetaIdealInclSnd a W s),
   139	    A.thetaIdealIncl_mem (a := a) W s⟩
   140	  map_add' s t := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext
   141	    (thetaIdealInclFst_add W s t) (thetaIdealInclSnd_add W s t))
   142	  map_smul' r s := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext
   143	    (thetaIdealInclFst_smul W r s) (thetaIdealInclSnd_smul W r s))

   145	@[simp]
   146	theorem thetaIdealInclApp_fst (W : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   147	    (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) :
   148	    (A.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) W s).val.1 = A.thetaIdealInclFst a W s := rfl
   149	
   150	@[simp]
   151	theorem thetaIdealInclApp_snd (W : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   152	    (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) :
   153	    (A.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) W s).val.2 = A.thetaIdealInclSnd a W s := rfl
   154	
   155	/-! ## Chartwise inverse sections
   156	
   157	On either pinned theta chart, a section whose germs lie in the local divisor ideal
   158	has the canonical lift supplied by `idealToGlued₀/₁`.  These identities are the
   159	local ingredients for the arbitrary-open range characterization below; importantly,
   160	they quantify over the actual open and do not introduce a chart-typed cover.
   161	-/
   162	
   163	theorem thetaIdealInclApp_idealToGlued₀
   164	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}
   165	    (hW : W ≤ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   166	    (β : Γ(relCurve C R, W))
   167	    (hβ : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (hz : z ∈ W),
   168	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ W z hz).hom β ∈ d.stalkIdeal z) :
   169	    A.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) W (idealToGlued₀ A a hW β hβ) =
   170	      (twistTriv₀ R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
   171	        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) hW).symm β := by
   172	  apply (twistTriv₀ R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
   173	    (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) hW).injective
   174	  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
   175	  change (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf le_rfl hW)
   176	      (gluedToIdeal₀ A a inf_le_right
   177	        (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left
   178	          (idealToGlued₀ A a hW β hβ))) = β
   179	  rw [gluedToIdeal₀_secRes (A := A) (a := a) inf_le_left hW
   180	    (idealToGlued₀ A a hW β hβ)]
   181	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   182	  rw [Scheme.resHom_self]
   183	  exact gluedToIdeal₀_idealToGlued₀ (A := A) (a := a) hW β hβ
   184	
   185	theorem thetaIdealInclApp_idealToGlued₁
   186	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}
   187	    (hW : W ≤ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   188	    (β : Γ(relCurve C R, W))
   189	    (hβ : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (hz : z ∈ W),
   190	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ W z hz).hom β ∈ d.stalkIdeal z) :
   191	    A.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) W (idealToGlued₁ A a hW β hβ) =
   192	      (twistTriv₁ R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
   193	        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) hW).symm β := by
   194	  apply (twistTriv₁ R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
   195	    (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) hW).injective
   196	  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
   197	  change (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf le_rfl hW)
   198	      (gluedToIdeal₁ A a inf_le_right
   199	        (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left
   200	          (idealToGlued₁ A a hW β hβ))) = β
   201	  rw [gluedToIdeal₁_secRes (A := A) (a := a) inf_le_left hW
   202	    (idealToGlued₁ A a hW β hβ)]
   203	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   204	  rw [Scheme.resHom_self]
   205	  exact gluedToIdeal₁_idealToGlued₁ (A := A) (a := a) hW β hβ
   206	
   207	/-- The sectionwise theta-ideal inclusion commutes with restriction. -/
   208	theorem thetaIdealInclApp_res {W' W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (h : W' ≤ W)
   209	    (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) :
   210	    A.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) W'
   211	        (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) h s) =
   212	      twistRes R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
   213	        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) h
   214	        (A.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) W s) := by
   215	  apply Subtype.ext
   216	  apply Prod.ext
   217	  · change gluedToIdeal₀ A a inf_le_right
   218	        (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left
   219	          (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) h s)) =
   220	      (relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf_right _ h)
   221	        (gluedToIdeal₀ A a inf_le_right
   222	          (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left s))
   223	    simpa only [secRes_secRes] using
   224	      (gluedToIdeal₀_secRes (A := A) (a := a) (inf_le_inf_right _ h)
   225	        inf_le_right (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf) inf_le_left s))

    11	/-!
    12	# The ε-pair and its pair-chart framing are CARRIER-INDIFFERENT
    13	
    14	The DD-R representability consumer asks for the chart-typed value: `divRepClassifyZar`
    15	(`Picard/DivRepClassifyZar.lean`) and `divFunctor_representableBy_of_chartRange`
    16	(`Picard/DivRepChartRange.lean`) both quantify over `DivFamZar`, and the chart data they need
    17	comes from `DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover` (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZarKit.lean`).  Since the
    18	widened comparison `DivFamZar.toAff` runs chart-typed → widened and has no reverse (a widened
    19	cover has no chart typing to recover, and manufacturing one is the fixed-pair confinement that
    20	protection I-0492 clause 3 forbids), it is natural to read this as "R2 has not reached the
    21	consumer".
    22	
    23	**That reading is wrong, and this file measures why.**  The chart dependency of
    24	`exists_certChartCover` does not run through the divisor's *cover* at all.  It runs through the
    25	**window**:
    26	
    27	* `divFamEps` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyWindow.lean`) is `divisorWindow G.eqns` at two windows, and
    28	  `eqns : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations` is a field of `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff` exactly as it
    29	  is of `CertifiedDivisorFamily`.  The cover never enters.
    30	* the framing clause is two equations between submodules of `R ⊗[k] H`, comparing
    31	  `Module.Grassmannian.map w` of a tautological subbundle against the base change of the window.
    32	  Neither side mentions a cover, a piece, or a chart typing of the divisor.
    33	
    34	So "which carrier the certificate lives on" and "where the ε-pair sits in the Grassmannian" are
    35	independent questions, and the widening is invisible to the second.  The declarations below say
    36	that in Lean rather than in prose: both are *statements* about a widened family, and their
    37	elaboration is the content.
    38	
    39	## What this does NOT claim
    40	
    41	It does not prove `exists_certChartCover` over the widened carrier.  What is established here is
    42	that no *type* obstruction stands in the way: the clause is expressible, so the remaining
    43	question is a proof, not a redesign.
    44	
    45	**A previous version of this paragraph priced that remaining proof as "runs the certificate
    46	cover and the per-piece frame covers, which is real work".  That over-priced it, and the reason
    47	generalises** (measured 2026-07-30, `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffFrameCover.lean`, inbox `I-1327`):
    48	`divFamEps_exists_frameCover` reads its *carrier* at exactly three points, all inside
    49	`exists_frame_chart_at_prime` — `Module.Finite`, `Module.Projective` and `rankAtStalk = g` of the
    50	window quotient `(R ⊗[k] H_a) ⧸ F.window`.  Everything below them takes a Grassmannian *point*
    51	and a base ring and cannot see what produced the submodule, and `divisorWindow` names no
    52	adaptation, cover or chart typing.  So the cover that proof runs belongs to `d`, which **both**
    53	carriers share.  A proof that "runs a cover" is chart-dependent only if the cover is indexed by
    54	the chart typing.
    55	
    56	The step that *was* real, and which the old pricing did not name, is the tower transport:
    57	`map_divFamWindowGr` obtains its composite from `DivFam.mapAlg_comp`, i.e. from the carrier's own
    58	functoriality, so carrier-free it has to be proved on the submodule
    59	(`windowBaseChange_windowBaseChange`, new).  None of this discharges an antecedent — see that
    60	file's `Reachability` section for the no-go that still blocks the widened side.
    61	
    62	## Main declarations
    63	
    64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.eps` — the ε-pair of a **widened** certified
    65	  family, computed from its `eqns` alone.
    66	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.IsPairChartFramed` — the framing clause of
    67	  `exists_certChartCover`, stated over the widened carrier.
    68	-/

    96	-- the window's `H`-finiteness instances are found through the moduleKSheaf tower, which
    97	-- exceeds the default instance budget
    98	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
    99	/-- **The ε-pair of a WIDENED certified family.**  Verbatim `divFamEps`, with the widened
   100	carrier in place of the chart-typed one — which type-checks because both carriers have the same
   101	`eqns : LocalEquations` field and `divisorWindow` reads nothing else.
   102	
   103	This is the declaration that refutes "the ε-pair needs the chart-typed value". -/
   104	noncomputable def eps (F : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C R g) :
   105	    Submodule R (R ⊗[k]
   106	        ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
   107	      × Submodule R (R ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
   108	          ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)) :=
   109	  (divisorWindow F.eqns (relThetaPairH1_windowM C pi hpi g),
   110	   divisorWindow F.eqns (relThetaPairH1_windowMS C pi hpi g))
   111	
   112	variable {r₁ r₂ : ℕ}
   113	variable (b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
   114	  (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
   115	variable (b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
   116	  ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
   117	
   118	-- same instance tower as `eps`, plus the Grassmannian side
   119	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   120	/-- **The pair-chart framing clause, over the WIDENED carrier.**  Exactly the two Grassmannian
   121	equations of `DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover`, with `divFamEps (DivFam.mk G)` replaced by
   122	`F.eps`.
   123	
   124	That this elaborates is the point: the framing is a condition on where the ε-pair sits in the
   125	Grassmannian, and the ε-pair does not know which cover certified the family.  So no *type*
   126	obstruction separates the widened carrier from the chart-cover extraction the representability
   127	consumer runs — see the module docstring for what is still owed. -/
   128	def IsPairChartFramed (F : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C R g)
   129	    (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
   130	    (w : PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j →ₐ[k] R) : Prop :=
   131	  (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautFst k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
   132	      = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange R b₁.equivFun.toLinearMap)
   133	        (F.eps hpi g).1
   134	    ∧ (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
   135	      = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange R b₂.equivFun.toLinearMap)
   136	        (F.eps hpi g).2
   137	
   138	-- `rfl`, but the window unfolds through the section-ring algebra instances and exceeds the
   139	-- default recursion depth on the way
   140	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   141	set_option maxRecDepth 4000 in
   142	/-- The ε-pair of a widened family is its two windows, by definition.  Recorded because it is
   143	the seam a restatement of `exists_certChartCover` would rewrite along. -/
   144	@[simp]
   145	lemma eps_fst (F : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C R g) :
   146	    (F.eps hpi g).1 = divisorWindow F.eqns (relThetaPairH1_windowM C pi hpi g) := rfl
   147

   150	set_option maxRecDepth 4000 in

   152	lemma eps_snd (F : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C R g) :

   259	/-- **The free-codomain (c4) flattening keystone**: for `ψ : M → N` with `M` finite, `N`
   260	free (any rank — infinite rank permitted) and `ψ ⊗ κ(p)` injective at every prime `p`, the
   261	cokernel `N ⧸ range ψ` is flat.  This drops the `[Module.Finite R N]` hypothesis of

   266	the localized cokernel; `Module.flat_of_localized_maximal` globalizes. -/
   267	theorem Module.Flat.quotient_range_of_forall_rTensor_residueField_injective_free
   268	    [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R N] (ψ : M →ₗ[R] N)
   269	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
   270	      Function.Injective (ψ.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :

   273	  intro J hJ

   279	      (LocalizedModule J.primeCompl (N ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ)) :=
   280	    Module.Flat.of_lTensor_residueField_injective_of_free
   281	      (LocalizedModule.map J.primeCompl ψ)
   282	      (LocalizedModule.map J.primeCompl (LinearMap.range ψ).mkQ)
   283	      (LocalizedModule.map_surjective _ _ (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _))

     9	/-!
    10	# Twisted affine Serre vanishing: degree-one cohomology of quasi-coherently packaged sheaves
    11	
    12	The Wave-4 keystone (G-CBC-3(ii)): for a scheme `X`, an affine open `U`, and a sheaf `F`
    13	of `k`-modules on the small Zariski site carrying the quasi-coherence packaging
    14	`Scheme.QcohOn F U` of `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.QcohSections` (ambient-section
    15	action + localization on affine opens of `U`), the degree-one cohomology of `U` with
    16	coefficients in `F` vanishes:
    17	`Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule' F U 1)`
    18	(`AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.subsingleton_hModule'_one_of_qcoh`); and for `X` itself
    19	affine, the degree-one cohomology of the site vanishes:
    20	`Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule F 1)`
    21	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.subsingleton_hModule_one_of_qcoh`).
    22	
    23	This generalizes the landed structure-sheaf engine of
    24	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.AffineVanishing` /
    25	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.AffineCech` off the structure sheaf: taking
    26	`F = X.moduleKSheaf k` (whose packaging instance lives in
    27	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.QcohSections`) recovers
    28	`IsAffineOpen.subsingleton_moduleKSheaf_hModule'_one`. The intended coefficients are the
    29	twisted line bundles of the Wave-4 representability route — sheaves glued from unit
    30	cocycles on finite affine trivializing covers — for which the packaging holds chartwise.
    31	
    32	## Proof architecture
    33	
    34	Verbatim Serre, as in `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.AffineVanishing`, with the packaging
    35	axioms in place of the structure-sheaf localization lemmas:
    36	
    37	* `IsAffineOpen.exists_cech_cobounding_of_qcoh` — every Čech 1-cocycle for `F` on a
    38	  finite basic-open cover of `U` is a coboundary: clear denominators with one uniform
    39	  exponent (packaging axiom `QcohOn.exists_secRes_eq_qsmul_pow`), annihilate the
    40	  triple-overlap defects (`QcohOn.exists_qsmul_pow_eq_zero`), and assemble along a
    41	  partition of unity `1 = ∑ h l · f l ^ (N + M)` of the affine `U` — the assembly needs
    42	  only that ambient sections act on `F`-sections compatibly with restriction (the (P1)
    43	  mixin).
    44	* `IsAffineOpen.cokernel_app_surjective_of_qcoh` — for a monomorphism `ι : F ⟶ G`,
    45	  sections of `cokernel ι` over `U` lift to `G`: local lifts on a finite basic cover
    46	  differ by an `F`-valued 1-cocycle, which cobounds; the corrected lifts glue.
    47	* `IsAffineOpen.subsingleton_hModule'_one_of_qcoh` — `H¹'(U, F) = Ext¹(k[U], F) = 0` by
    48	  `Abelian.Ext.subsingleton_one_of_injective_of_surjective` applied to `Injective.ι F`,
    49	  with the section surjectivity above; `Scheme.subsingleton_hModule_one_of_qcoh`
    50	  transports along `Sheaf.HModule.linearEquivHModule'` for affine `X`.
    51	-/

    64	/-- At every object of the site, the kernel of the cokernel projection of a monomorphism
    65	of sheaves of modules is the pointwise range of that monomorphism. -/
    66	theorem ker_cokernelπ_app_eq_range {F G : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u} R)}
    67	    (ι : F ⟶ G) [Mono ι] (U : Cᵒᵖ) :
    68	    LinearMap.ker ((cokernel.π ι).hom.app U).hom =
    69	      LinearMap.range (ι.hom.app U).hom := by
    70	  ext c
    71	  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_range]
    72	  constructor
    73	  · intro hc
    74	    exact exists_app_eq_of_cokernelπ_app_eq_zero ι U c hc

    76	    have hnat := congrArg (fun f : F ⟶ cokernel ι ↦ f.hom.app U)

    78	    have hlin := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hnat

    81	/-- If the cokernel projection is surjective at one object, its value there is linearly
    82	equivalent to the quotient by the pointwise range of the original monomorphism. -/

    88	  (((cokernel.π ι).hom.app U).hom.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj).symm.trans

   102	/-- **Degree-one Čech cobounding for a quasi-coherently packaged sheaf on an affine
   103	open.** Let `U` be an affine open of a scheme `X`, covered by finitely many basic opens
   104	`D(f i)`, and let `F` be a sheaf of `k`-modules with the quasi-coherence packaging on `U`.
   105	Every 1-cocycle `a i j` of `F`-sections on the pairwise intersections is a coboundary:
   106	there are sections `b i` of `F` on `D(f i)` with `a i j = b i - b j` on `D(f i) ⊓ D(f j)`.
   107	
   108	This is `IsAffineOpen.exists_cech_cobounding` with structure-sheaf coefficients replaced
   109	by `F` (Serre's partition-of-unity argument, run through the packaging axioms). -/
   110	theorem exists_cech_cobounding_of_qcoh (hU : IsAffineOpen U) [Scheme.QcohOn F U] {n : ℕ}
   111	    (f : Fin n → Γ(X, U)) (hcov : ⨆ i, X.basicOpen (f i) = U)
   112	    (a : ∀ i j, F.obj.obj (op (X.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (f j))))
   113	    (hc : ∀ i j l,
   114	      secRes F (inf_le_inf_right (X.basicOpen (f l)) inf_le_left) (a i l) =
   115	        secRes F inf_le_left (a i j) +
   116	          secRes F (inf_le_inf_right (X.basicOpen (f l)) inf_le_right) (a j l)) :
   117	    ∃ b : ∀ i, F.obj.obj (op (X.basicOpen (f i))),
   118	      ∀ i j, a i j = secRes F inf_le_left (b i) - secRes F inf_le_right (b j) := by
   119	  classical
   120	  have haff : ∀ i : Fin n, IsAffineOpen (X.basicOpen (f i)) := fun i ↦ hU.basicOpen (f i)
   121	  have haff2 : ∀ i j : Fin n, IsAffineOpen (X.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (f j)) := by
   122	    intro i j
   123	    rw [← X.basicOpen_mul]
   124	    exact hU.basicOpen _
   125	  -- Step 1: clear denominators, with a uniform exponent `N`.
   126	  choose N₀ e₀ he₀ using fun i j ↦

    10	# Certified base change on the widened cover (R2, human decision I-0492)
    11	
    12	The seven certificate clauses of `AffAdaptation.IsCertified` transport along an arbitrary test
    13	change `R → R'`.  This is the last structural piece the widened value needed: without it
    14	`DivFamZarAff` is a type with no functoriality, and nothing downstream can base-change a
    15	widened class.
    16	
    17	## Two definitional identities do most of the work
    18	
    19	Both were probed and hold on the nose, which is why this file is short:
    20	
    21	* the base-changed overlap **is** the preimage of the overlap
    22	  (`(D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j = relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ (pieces i ⊓
    23	  pieces j)` by `rfl`, since `⁻¹ᵁ` commutes with `⊓` definitionally on `Opens`);
    24	* the pulled colength **is** the quotient `relQuotBaseChangeAff` lands in.
    25	
    26	So the widened colength and overlap transports are the SAME declaration
    27	(`AffCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange`) at two different opens, where the chart-typed layer
    28	needed `pieceQuotBaseChange` and a separately-constructed `ovlQuotBaseChange` conjugated
    29	through the overlap generator.
    30	
    31	## What is reused verbatim
    32	
    33	Clauses (c2)/(c3)/(c4) ride the abstract `FlatCokernel` keystones
    34	(`LinearMap.ker_lTensor_eq_of_flat_coker`, `LinearMap.tensorKerEquivOfFlatCoker`,
    35	`LinearMap.quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv`) and the two square-transport lemmas
    36	(`LinearEquiv.map_ker_of_comp_eq`, `LinearEquiv.range_eq_map_range_of_comp_eq`).  All are
    37	stated for bare modules and know nothing about covers, so the widening does not touch them.
    38	
    39	## Main declarations
    40	
    41	* `AffAdaptation.colengthBaseChange`, `ovlColengthBaseChange` — the (c1) and overlap
    42	  transports, both `AffCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange`.
    43	* `AffAdaptation.chartProdBaseChange`, `ovlProdBaseChange` — the product transports.
    44	* `AffAdaptation.delta_baseChange_comm` — `δ`-naturality, a `funext` over the pair index.
    45	* `AffAdaptation.gluedBaseChange` and the (c2)/(c3)/(c4) transports.
    46	* `AffAdaptation.isCertified_pullback` — **the certificate base-changes**, all seven clauses.
    47	-/

    99	    R' ⊗[R] A.ovlColength i j ≃ₐ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlColength i j :=
   100	  (relQuotBaseChangeAff C R' (hinf i j)
   101	      {relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) (A.eqn i),
   102	       relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) (A.eqn j)}).trans
   103	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R' (by
   104	      rw [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
   105	      exact congrArg₂ (fun x y => Ideal.span {x, y})
   106	        (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
   107	          (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) (A.eqn i)).symm
   108	        (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
   109	          (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) (A.eqn j)).symm))

   114	    A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj j
   115	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t) =
   116	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(A.pullback R' hproj).eqn j})
   117	        (D.piecesMap R' j t) := by
   118	  rw [colengthBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
   119	    AffCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange_one_tmul_mk, Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk]

   122	    (hinf : ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) (i j : D.index)
   123	    (t : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
   124	    A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf i j
   125	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal i j) t) =
   126	      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((A.pullback R' hproj).ovlIdeal i j)
   127	        (relAffSectionsMap C R' (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) t) := by
   128	  rw [ovlColengthBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, relQuotBaseChangeAff_one_tmul_mk]
   129	  exact Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk R' _ _

   141	    (hinf : ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
   142	    R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd ≃ₗ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlProd :=
   143	  (TensorProduct.piRight R R' R'
   144	      (fun p : D.index × D.index => A.ovlColength p.1 p.2)).trans
   145	    (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight fun p =>
   146	      (A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2).toLinearEquiv)

   164	/-! ## The overlap-restriction squares
   165	
   166	The chart-typed proofs of these consumed `ovlMap_resHom_left`/`_right`, which conjugate through
   167	the overlap generator.  Widened, the corresponding fact is `relAffSectionsMap_res` — plain
   168	`appLE` naturality at `pieces i ⊓ pieces j`. -/
   169	
   170	section Squares
   171	
   172	/-- The left overlap-restriction map on a residue class (the widened mirror of the `private`
   173	`toOvlLeft_mk` of `DivisorFamilyPullbackCert.lean`). -/
   174	private lemma toOvlLeft_mk' (i j : D.index) (t : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)) :
   175	    A.toOvlLeft i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t) =
   176	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal i j) (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_left t) :=
   177	  rfl
   178	
   179	/-- The right overlap-restriction map on a residue class. -/
   180	private lemma toOvlRight_mk' (i j : D.index) (t : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)) :
   181	    A.toOvlRight i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t) =
   182	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal i j) (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_right t) :=
   183	  rfl
   184	
   185	variable (hinf : ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))
   186	
   187	lemma pulledToOvlLeft_colengthBaseChange (i j : D.index) (x : R' ⊗[R] A.colength i) :
   188	    (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlLeft i j (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj i x) =
   189	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf i j
   190	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft i j).toLinearMap) x) := by
   191	  induction x with
   192	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   193	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
   194	  | tmul r' y =>
   195	    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
   196	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t) :
   197	        R' ⊗[R] A.colength i) =
   198	        r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) := by
   199	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
   200	    rw [hsmul]
   201	    simp only [map_smul]
   202	    congr 1
   203	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft i j).toLinearMap)
   204	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) =
   205	        (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) :=
   206	      rfl
   207	    rw [A.colengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk R' hproj i t, hlt, A.toOvlLeft_mk' i j t,
   208	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk R' hproj hinf i j _,
   209	      (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlLeft_mk' i j _]
   210	    exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _)
   211	      (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
   212	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) t)
   213	
   214	lemma pulledToOvlRight_colengthBaseChange (i j : D.index) (x : R' ⊗[R] A.colength j) :
   215	    (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlRight i j (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj j x) =
   216	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf i j
   217	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlRight i j).toLinearMap) x) := by
   218	  induction x with
   219	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   220	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
   221	  | tmul r' y =>
   222	    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
   223	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t) :
   224	        R' ⊗[R] A.colength j) =
   225	        r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t)) := by
   226	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
   227	    rw [hsmul]
   228	    simp only [map_smul]
   229	    congr 1
   230	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlRight i j).toLinearMap)
   231	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t)) =
   232	        (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlRight i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t)) :=
   233	      rfl
   234	    rw [A.colengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk R' hproj j t, hlt, A.toOvlRight_mk' i j t,
   235	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk R' hproj hinf i j _,
   236	      (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlRight_mk' i j _]
   237	    exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _)
   238	      (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
   239	        (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) t)

   241	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
   242	-- The defeq checks through the mixed `relCurve`/product spellings are heavy here, exactly as in
   243	-- the chart-typed `delta_baseChange_comm` (`DivisorFamilyPullbackCert.lean`), and the instance
   244	-- searches on the large tensor/product types exceed the default.
   245	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   246	/-- **`δ`-naturality**: the pulled difference arrow matches `id ⊗ δ` through the product
   247	transports.  A `funext` over the pair index feeding the two squares above — index-shape
   248	agnostic, so the widening costs nothing here. -/
   249	theorem delta_baseChange_comm :
   250	    ((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft - (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight) ∘ₗ
   251	        (A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj :
   252	          R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd →ₗ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).chartProd) =
   253	      (A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf :
   254	          R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd →ₗ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlProd) ∘ₗ
   255	        AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) := by
   256	  apply LinearMap.ext
   257	  intro x
   258	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
   259	  induction x with
   260	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   261	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
   262	  | tmul r' s =>
   263	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s : R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd) = r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) := by
   264	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
   265	    rw [hsmul]
   266	    simp only [map_smul]
   267	    congr 1
   268	    funext p
   269	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
   270	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) s) := rfl
   271	    have hcomp : (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) s =
   272	        fun p : D.index × D.index =>
   273	          A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1) - A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2) := by
   274	      funext q
   275	      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, deltaLeft, deltaRight, LinearMap.pi_apply,
   276	        LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
   277	        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
   278	    have hL : (((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft - (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight)
   279	        ((A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj) ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s))) p =
   280	        (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlLeft p.1 p.2
   281	            (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj p.1 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1)) -
   282	          (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlRight p.1 p.2
   283	            (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2)) := by
   284	      have h1 := A.chartProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' hproj 1 s p.1
   285	      have h2 := A.chartProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' hproj 1 s p.2
   286	      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, Pi.sub_apply, deltaLeft, deltaRight,
   287	        LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
   288	        LinearMap.proj_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, h1, h2]
   289	    have hR : ((A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf)
   290	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
   291	          ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s))) p =
   292	        A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2
   293	            ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1))) -
   294	          A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2
   295	            ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2))) := by
   296	      rw [hlt, A.ovlProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' hproj hinf 1 _ p, hcomp,
   297	        TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub]
   298	    have hltL : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2).toLinearMap)
   299	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1) = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1)) := rfl
   300	    have hltR : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2).toLinearMap)
   301	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2) = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2)) := rfl
   302	    rw [hL, hR,
   303	      A.pulledToOvlLeft_colengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1),
   304	      A.pulledToOvlRight_colengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2),
   305	      hltL, hltR]
   306	
   307	/-- The `δ`-naturality square with the verticals inverted. -/
   308	theorem delta_baseChange_comm' :
   309	    (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) ∘ₗ
   310	        ((A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj).symm :
   311	          (A.pullback R' hproj).chartProd →ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd) =
   312	      ((A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf).symm :
   313	          (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlProd →ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd) ∘ₗ
   314	        ((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft - (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight) := by
   315	  apply LinearMap.ext
   316	  intro x
   317	  have h := congr($(A.delta_baseChange_comm R' hproj hinf)
   318	    ((A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj).symm x))
   319	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
   320	    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h ⊢
   321	  rw [h, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
